why_this_corpus: frozen polyglot fixture tree: committed, offline, and its digest moves only on a deliberate fixture change, so a baseline stays comparable across releases. crates/codingest/src is the code under test and its digest moves nearly every release, which would make the gate REFUSE every time.
stored_value: min of 3 runs per query (repeatable inner loop); build_secs is the mean of 3 runs (once-per-build cost has no floor to find)
build_gating: recorded, not enforced: at 46 KB the build is dominated by one-time grammar init. Node/edge counts carry the build-side signal and are deterministic here (zero spread across three runs in both modes).
stability_across_3_runs: worst per-query spread 0.001 ms docs-on / 0.002 ms docs-off across three runs per mode after a discarded warmup run per mode; node and edge counts identical across all runs in both modes and the cross-build parity flag held on every cell. FLOOR HELD AT 0.005 on the standing rationale (0.2.10-0.2.12): 0.005 is 2.5x the cross-session evidence (0.002 spreads recurring at 0.2.9/0.2.10 and again in this session). Two earlier capture sets this session were discarded before recording, not averaged over: the first ran beside an unrelated workspace's cargo test (0.004 spreads), and a post-compile set read a one-cell 0.006 wander on defs_per_file that a settled re-measure did not reproduce (0.002) - wandering, not deterministic. Eighth baseline of the 0.2.6 corpus epoch (c449542e, 30 corpora). Control top20_by_branch_count re-qualified across the kglite 0.16.17->0.16.18 engine move (zero engine changes upstream): release-gate anchor compare vs 0.2.10 read it +12.50% docs-on / +6.25% docs-off, instrument steady, and it clears 2x the 0.005 floor in both modes (0.015-0.017 ms medians).
